notes.title: PCC Architecture & Data Integrity Standards
notes.content:
# PCC Data Seeding & Backup Architecture

- **Primary Storage**: Browser LocalStorage backed by local SQLite server state.
- **Currency & Regional**: Default symbol `₹ (INR)`, Location `Pune, MH, IN`.
- **Schema Validation**: Validated on import with fallbacks for optional fields.
- **Export**: ISO 8601 timestamps with nested entity arrays.
